request: Add an optional generic private assistant-agent extension with scoped host IPC and existing tool permission enforcement
acceptance: One enabled provider replaces built-in decision loop; disabled provider restores built-in
Host-only stdin IPC, no provider credentials in plugin/model args
Locked, stale workspace or disabled provider cancels access; no silent legacy fallback on active-provider failure
Text, continuous voice and native audio use the same provider contract
Only existing allowed host tools remain callable; no privilege expansion
Public files contain only generic contract and neutral fixtures

requirements.summary: Optional replacement provider with explicit lifecycle and host permissions.

design.summary: Versioned host-only IPC and generic native context contract.

implementation.summary: Text, voice and native context integration with explicit active-provider errors.

verification.summary: Focused Go race tests passed (18.608s); isolated installed package and browser synthetic dialogue passed. Live native provider and full Go suite NOT_RUN.

documentation.summary: Generic contract documented; plugin-owned records moved to owning repositories.

cleanup.summary: Only owned isolated browser fixture stopped; live service unchanged.

release.summary: Candidate review only; no merge, release, market publication or live deployment authorized.

rollback: Disable the optional provider to restore built-in agent on next interaction; reverting host commit removes the candidate interface.
handoff: Generic host candidate only. Provider-private implementation and evidence remain outside this repository.
